Subject: Request: Access artifacts for upcoming SIG questionnaire

Hi Vanessa,

We are preparing our SIG submission and the assessor has asked for a compact evidence bundle from Redwood covering SSO/SCIM/RBAC and least-privilege controls. Can you share the following artifacts by EOB Thu 24 Sep?

- A sample SAML assertion (redacted) and typical SAML attribute mapping
- A SCIM delta export (examples showing create/update/delete events)
- Current RBAC matrix (roles -> permissions -> example owners)
- A short description of how least-privilege is enforced for service accounts and delegated admin
- Any logs or snapshots proving role assignment timelines (last 90 days)

We prefer a secure Drive upload or a single archive via the vendor portal link in HubSpot. If you need a formal evidence transfer form, I attached the HealthBridge intake (healthbridge_access_req_form.pdf).

Thanks — this is time sensitive for our assessor. Let me know if a 30-min kickoff helps.

Best,

4) Logs: role assignment timeline (last 90 days) requires RBAC owner sign-off; I've collated audit entries for two representative changes.

Requests / blockers:
- Need security to scrub any PII from the delta before upload. @Marcus, can you confirm IT/security redaction?
- Confirm redaction level for NameID in SAML (Vanessa, did Elena confirm?).

I'll upload preliminary files to our internal evidence folder and send a share link once redaction is complete. Stubbing attachments here: saml_samples.zip (zip), scim_delta_sample.csv (csv), rbac_snapshot_20260922.xlsx (xlsx).
